note: 真·保留集（只跑一次，不参与任何调参）。P 集在调词表时已被看过，已失去保留性，仅作为『调优前后对照』保留。

cases.q: 昨天的活跃用户数
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT da.user_id) AS metric FROM daily_active da WHERE da.log_date = '2026-06-29'

cases.q: 各个渠道昨天带来多少收入
cases.gold: SELECT u.channel AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.order_date = '2026-06-29' GROUP BY u.channel

cases.q: 最近30天各国家付费用户数
cases.gold: SELECT u.country AS dim, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.country

cases.q: 最近90天收入
cases.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-04-02' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30'

cases.q: 2026年5月各渠道的收入
cases.gold: SELECT u.channel AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-05-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY u.channel

cases.q: 收入最高的那一天是多少
cases.gold: SELECT p.order_date AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p GROUP BY p.order_date ORDER BY metric DESC LIMIT 1

cases.q: 各渠道最近30天的收入和订单数
cases.gold: SELECT u.channel AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.channel

cases.q: 最近30天ARPPU
cases.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30'

cases.q: 各个商品类型的平均订单金额
cases.gold: SELECT pr.product_type AS dim, ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id GROUP BY pr.product_type

cases.q: 最近7天活跃用户里付费的有多少
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS metric FROM purchases p WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-24' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' AND p.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM daily_active WHERE log_date >= '2026-06-24' AND log_date <= '2026-06-30')

cases.q: 各VIP等级最近30天平均时长
cases.gold: SELECT u.vip_level AS dim, ROUND(AVG(da.play_minutes), 2) AS metric FROM daily_active da JOIN users u ON da.user_id = u.user_id WHERE da.log_date >= '2026-06-01' AND da.log_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.vip_level

cases.q: 最近30天订单量最多的3个国家
cases.gold: SELECT u.country AS dim, COUNT(*) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.country ORDER BY metric DESC LIMIT 3

cases.q: 本月新增用户数
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS metric FROM users u WHERE u.register_date >= '2026-06-01' AND u.register_date <= '2026-06-30'

cases.q: 各渠道最近7天人均会话数
cases.gold: SELECT u.channel AS dim, ROUND(SUM(da.sessions) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT da.user_id), 2) AS metric FROM daily_active da JOIN users u ON da.user_id = u.user_id WHERE da.log_date >= '2026-06-24' AND da.log_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.channel

cases.q: 最近30天各商品类型的收入占比
cases.gold: SELECT pr.product_type AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM purchases WHERE order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND order_date <= '2026-06-30'), 4) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY pr.product_type

cases.q: 上月付费用户数
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS metric FROM purchases p WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-05-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-05-31'

cases.q: 最近30天各渠道ARPPU
cases.gold: SELECT u.channel AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.channel

cases.q: 每天的平均时长（最近7天）
cases.gold: SELECT da.log_date AS dim, ROUND(AVG(da.play_minutes), 2) AS metric FROM daily_active da WHERE da.log_date >= '2026-06-24' AND da.log_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY da.log_date

cases.q: 2026年4月收入
cases.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-04-30'

cases.q: 最近30天各国家会话数
cases.gold: SELECT u.country AS dim, SUM(da.sessions) AS metric FROM daily_active da JOIN users u ON da.user_id = u.user_id WHERE da.log_date >= '2026-06-01' AND da.log_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.country
